fact_types.title: Are you a married taxpayer whose filing status is married filing separately or head of household (2025 Form 1040 instructions, line 27a, Step 3 question 3)? Yes means married at the end of 2025. Publication 596, Rule 3, still treats a head of household who lived apart as married. Yes continues to the separated-spouse questions. No means not married at the end of 2025, so those questions are skipped. Asked of a head of household with a qualifying child, including one who already answered the separated-spouse question no. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession.

Inactive second path for the Step 3 question 3 selection. Nothing asks this fact and no return records it. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession.
